notes: Per-atom dispatch scenarios with a fixture input and a response-shape assertion. The eval runner installs each atom, calls atom_invoke with the fixture args, and asserts the returned response shape contains the named fields. The recording adapter (see behavior-smoke.json) is the v1 default for behavior assertions; this suite covers the install-then-dispatch surface only.
